title: Inter are top of Serie A — and Chivu said they were lucky
caption:
Inter went top of Serie A at Venezia on two own goals, and Chivu told Sky Sport Italia "we were lucky today to bring it home." Gazzetta says Dimarco's new deal still hasn't moved. Derby Saturday.
